svg.title: Give the agent the access its task needs
svg.desc: An agent updating a manuscript figure has configured access to specific resources. Inside research-project/, it can read approved inputs without changing them, and edit the plotting script and saved figure. A separate browser page permits consulting public software documentation without sending project data. A stopped connection blocks another study's folder. These limits require controls for file tools, commands, and connections; choosing a folder alone does not establish them.
